purpose: Concept images for visual direction, not implemented 3D assets

prompts.name: TRAQUEUR
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: visual direction concept for a robot combat game's garage modules, one concept image.
Create an attractive simplified stylized 3D game-art illustration, not a manufactured product photograph. Bold readable large shapes, playful practical salvaged machinery, softly chamfered chunky metal, broad clean shading and very sparse hand-painted wear. This belongs to a rounded expressive workshop robot made of worn ivory metal and warm ochre armor. Keep surface detail subordinate to a memorable silhouette. Steel joints, restrained cream/ochre paint, small copper components where functional. No common rectangular backing box, no repeated ivory side-rail frame. No tiny screws, dense circuitry, ornamental panels or realistic microtexture. Easy to reproduce as an economical 3D game model.
Composition: square concept sheet, a single large isolated three-quarter module taking 70 percent of the sheet, soft neutral slate-gray background and studio workshop lighting. Entire object visible, clean margin. Along the bottom, one small pure black solid silhouette of exactly this object, on a lighter gray inset, to show thumbnail recognition. A discreet clear French name at the top. No full robot, no people, no gameplay UI, no additional objects, no annotations other than the exact module name.
Subject: TRAQUEUR passive module: ONE oversized spherical mechanical eye, a chunky cyan optical pupil looking alert, set in a rounded ochre eyelid brow. The eyeball is held by a small asymmetric pivot fork on a short stout swiveling stem with one simple mounting foot, like an expressive watchful robot eyeball. Open space around the ball and fork must define its silhouette. The eye and short stalk are the clear dominant shapes, no rectangular housing or flat disc with side guards. It is a compact arm-mounted component, not a giant standalone turret. One obvious swivel joint, just one thick short cable entering the stem. Restrained glow inside the pupil only.
Text (verbatim): "TRAQUEUR".
